outputs: - work-item identity, repository identity, base revision, branch, and worktree
- size classification and selected stage set
- written specification, delivery plan, implementation plan, and ordered tasks
- decision record with rejected alternatives and reasons
- per-task briefs, worker reports, review reports, and classified findings

protected_invariants.heading: Purpose
protected_invariants.text: Batman has one canonical name and body. `superman` is a keyword alias for this same protocol. Do not create, maintain, register, or generate a separate Superman capability.

protected_invariants.heading: Agent Operating Contract
protected_invariants.text: Batman is active only when the user explicitly invokes `batman`, invokes `superman`, or asks for this evidence-gated controller protocol by intent. Capability Fabric descriptors and relationship hints remain advisory; they do not auto-route work or grant execution authority.

protected_invariants.text: - Use Batman when the parent must remain a controller rather than becoming the implementer after research.

protected_invariants.heading: Invocation Hints

protected_invariants.heading: Output Directory
protected_invariants.text: Store the controller ledger and run-scoped scratch evidence under the repository's ignored validation directory when one exists; otherwise use a temporary directory outside canonical source. The first line must name the work item and base revision.

protected_invariants.text: Do not commit transient scratch. Preserve durable evidence in the PR or MR description, an approved report path, or another repository-defined evidence artifact before removing scratch.

protected_invariants.heading: Workflow
protected_invariants.text: Run stages in order. Do not ask for permission between ordinary, reversible stages already covered by the user's request. Do not interpret that continuity as authority for a critical or destructive action.

protected_invariants.text: 4. Select only the seats required by the current stage. Never instruct the host to use all agents, skills, or tools.

protected_invariants.heading: Preflight — Verify and discover
protected_invariants.text: While a worker runs, update the ledger and prepare the next brief. Use bounded waits appropriate to the host. If a worker makes no reportable progress after the bounded wait, cancel or interrupt it and dispatch a narrower brief. Do not retry the same vague brief.

protected_invariants.text: A correction for a shipped defect is never trivial.

protected_invariants.heading: Stage 1 — Research and challenge
protected_invariants.text: 1. Context seat: explain how the affected system actually works with files, lines, state, and observed behavior. Do not design.

protected_invariants.heading: Stage 1 — Research and challenge
protected_invariants.text: 2. SuperCharge seat: call the existing SuperCharge capability as a lens. Use `/adversarial /debate` to test the premise, falsifiers, and cheapest correct slice. Use `/full` only when the written plan justifies the full gauntlet; `/full` is not an instruction to run every installed capability.

protected_invariants.heading: Stage 1 — Research and challenge
protected_invariants.text: Gate: if the problem is misframed, revise the scope. Do not design the original wrong object.

protected_invariants.heading: Stage 2 — Design, simplify, specify, and plan
protected_invariants.text: Do not begin TDD until all four written artifacts—specification, delivery plan, implementation plan, and tasks—exist and agree.

protected_invariants.heading: Stage 3 — TDD-led implementation
protected_invariants.text: 1. Create a dedicated branch from current main, preferably in an isolated worktree. Never implement on `main` unless the user explicitly requires it and repository policy allows it.

protected_invariants.heading: Stage 3 — TDD-led implementation
protected_invariants.text: 2. Dispatch one independent implementer per bounded task. Provide only the task brief and required context, not a session-history dump.

protected_invariants.heading: Stage 3 — TDD-led implementation
protected_invariants.text: 4. The implementer reports the exact command and a sanitized relevant red excerpt. A test that was never observed red is not evidence.

protected_invariants.heading: Stage 3 — TDD-led implementation
protected_invariants.text: 7. Test design lives in the failing tests. Do not add a second post-hoc test-design ceremony after implementation.

protected_invariants.heading: Stage 3 — TDD-led implementation
protected_invariants.text: 10. Re-review the fix diff. After five unresolved rounds, stop for a human ruling. Do not silently park a Critical or Important finding.

protected_invariants.heading: Stage 3 — TDD-led implementation
protected_invariants.text: 11. Do not begin the next task while a Critical or Important finding remains unresolved.

protected_invariants.heading: Stage 4 — Validation and verification
protected_invariants.text: Run the repository-required formatter, linter, strict type checks, targeted tests, and full offline suite. Record exact commands and outcomes.

protected_invariants.heading: Stage 4 — Validation and verification
protected_invariants.text: Never weaken a claim to make validation pass. If a claim cannot be verified, refuse the claim and report the missing proof. A refusal is a successful answer.

protected_invariants.heading: Stage 5 — Code review and address review
protected_invariants.text: 3. Convergence seat: classify every finding as `MUST-FIX`, `CHEAP`, `TRACKED`, or `REJECT`. Resolve disagreement; do not average or silently dismiss it.

protected_invariants.heading: Stage 5 — Code review and address review
protected_invariants.text: 4. Address accepted review findings through the implementer or assigned fixer, never through the controller.

protected_invariants.heading: Stage 6 — Document, land, and clean
protected_invariants.text: 3. Open a scoped PR or MR whose description reports measurements and evidence, not only intent.

protected_invariants.heading: Stage 6 — Document, land, and clean
protected_invariants.text: 4. Verify current hosted CI on every required forge. Do not infer hosted CI from local tests.

protected_invariants.heading: Stage 6 — Document, land, and clean
protected_invariants.text: 7. Remove run-scoped scratch. Delete the delivery branch and worktree only when authorized and safe.

protected_invariants.text: - Dispatch only the seats required by the current stage.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - SuperCharge is a called lens. Batman is not a SuperCharge module and must not be added to `/full`, `/ult`, or any other SuperCharge module list.

protected_invariants.text: - `superman` is an alias only; no Superman SSOT, descriptor, skill, agent, or generated surface.

protected_invariants.text: - No live write, deployment, push, publish, merge, destructive cleanup, or security-sensitive action without the required authority.
